goCachePolicy: Owner ruling 2026-10-30 (impl-plans/conventions.md section 7). The following are user-level tool caches outside the repository: the mise-installed Go toolchain, the default GOCACHE (~/Library/Caches/go-build) and GOMODCACHE (~/go/pkg/mod), or their replacements /tmp/telescreen-<planId>-gocache and /tmp/telescreen-gdp-gomodcache. They need no artifactRoots entry, are not tracked by fanout change tracking, and are never a reason to report a blocker. go/vendor is committed source. The only repository artifact root is go/bin (gdp-p10).
goTestCountPolicy: Owner ruling 2026-10-31 (impl-plans/conventions.md section 7; design section 16). Go behavioral evidence comes only from `cd go && GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOFLAGS=-mod=vendor mise exec -- go test -count=1 -v ./... > <log> 2>&1`, which must exit 0. testsRun = `grep -c -- '--- PASS:' <log>` and must be > 0 (owner baseline 88). failureCount = `grep -c -- '--- FAIL:' <log>` and must be 0. mise run go-test may be listed only with the counts from that same verbose log, never with testsRun 0.
artifactPolicy: Owner resolution run 3 -> run 4 (gdp-p10 Progress Log) and the 2026-10-08 ruling (conventions section 7). The only repository build outputs are go/bin/telescreen-gdrive-police (mise run go-build) and go/bin/telescreen-gdrive-police-e2e (the E2E). Both are built with -trimpath into the gitignored artifact root go/bin, and both are rebuilt in run 5. Their sha256 values and `mise exec -- go version` (go1.27.3) are recorded in the gdp-p10 Progress Log. uv build always uses --out-dir /tmp/telescreen-gdp-p10-dist, never dist/. The following are not artifacts, need no artifactRoots entry and never block: pytest tmp_path, /tmp, Go caches and gitignored tool caches (.pytest_cache, .ruff_cache, __pycache__, .venv). mise.toml is not edited. The literal mise run ci is an owner step after the workflow.
gitleaksPolicy: Owner ruling 2026-10-30 (conventions section 7; design section 16). Run gitleaks from the repository root with --config .gitleaks.toml. `mise exec -- gitleaks dir --config .gitleaks.toml --redact <path>` runs once per tracked gdp path and never on '.' or 'go', so gitignored tmp/, .venv and go/bin are never scanned. gdp-p10 scans its own source paths (go/cmd/telescreen-gdrive-police, tests/go_police). Serial finalization scans the full design section 16 path list and runs the gitleaks git staged, ae4ba45..HEAD and whole-history scans. Synthetic secrets use the xor-v1 *_b64 fixture encoding or fragments assembled at run time. Never add path-wide allowlists.
shellPreamble: Every verification shell starts with `set -o pipefail` and `export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1` (conventions section 7), then `EV=tmp/telescreen-gdp-20261031-h5/gdp-p10-cmd-e2e/attempt-<n>; mkdir -p "$EV"`. Run every command in the foreground. Record each command in the plan Progress Log with its exit status and full log path. An incomplete log is not a pass. A command that only skips is not evidence.
